subject: Exec readout: KPI flags, owners and QBR sprint prep
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KPI flags + QBR sprint — quick sync and owners

Team —

Quick readout before the 3/16 QBR: the dashboard for February surfaced three primary flags I want triaged this week so we can include mitigation steps in the exec slide deck. High-level items:

- Latency: p95 for text-gen increased from 190ms -> 310ms on March 2 for the hosted API region-us-west-2 (appears correlated with a model rollout).
- Cost: token unit cost spiked ~22% week-over-week for a single large customer (Acme Analytics) due to a configuration change; need billing/usage cross-check.
- Uptime: two short infra restarts on 2027-03-04 (total ~6m) caused a small customer complaint; we should capture RCA and postmortem blurb.

I attached the QBR_KPI_snapshot_Mar2027.pdf and an export of the token/cost traces. Can each of you own one item and reply with a 48-hour plan?

Proposed owners:
- Markus: latency spike triage + rollback plan (if needed)
- Irene: uptime postmortem + suggested blurb for QBR
- Laura: customer-cost reconciliation (Acme) + billing note for execs
- Marissa: slide updates and one-page action tracker

Please reply with confirmations and any immediate blockers. I will consolidate into the exec deck by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_KPI_snapshot_Mar2027.pdf, cost-latency-spike-log.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KPI flags + QBR sprint — quick sync and owners

Jordan / team —

I'll take the latency item. Quick summary of what I'll do in the next 48h:
1) Confirm if the March 2 model rollout touched kernel selection or batch configs (likely candidate).
2) Run a controlled canary rollback to the previous model build on a small pool and compare p95 by sequence length.
3) If rollback reproduces baseline, prepare a short rollback playbook and a mitigations list (quantization profile, batch-size guardrails).

Immediate blocker: need the exact model build id used in that rollout (hoping Irene's deploy logs have it). If someone can paste the deploy tag I can start. I'll post the canary comparison and a short decision note in the Drive link once complete.

-Markus

Total customer impact ~6m (no data leakage). I'll pull the kube events and the infra logs; ETA for a concise RCA blurb is 24 hours.

Jordan / Marissa —

I'll take the Acme billing reconciliation. Initial findings from the export: Acme flipped a config to request longer context windows for batch jobs on 3/1 which increased token consumption per request by ~18%. Combined with an unexpected multiplier in our metering for deduped-cache hits, their bill jumped.

Planned next steps (48h):
- Confirm exact timestamps and correlate with HubSpot usage events (I have the HS deal open: HS-78393).
- Contact Acme (Sarah) to confirm they intentionally changed the config and capture a short quote for the QBR slide. I'll include a suggested credit amount if the config change was uncoordinated.
- Produce a one-line billing blurb for the exec deck.

I'll loop in Sarah at Acme if you want me to get a direct confirmation.

Laura
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cost-latency-spike-log.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: KPI flags + QBR sprint — quick sync and owners

All — quick status update and a lightweight action table for the exec slide. I'm assembling slides and will have a single-slide summary per flag and one action register. Current plan:

1) Latency (Markus) — canary comparison scheduled for 3/09 11:00 PDT; deliverable: p95 comparison chart + recommended rollback by EOD 3/09.
2) Cost (Laura) — customer confirmation in-flight; deliverable: recommended credit proposal + billing blurb by 3/10.
3) Uptime (Irene) — RCA blurb and mitigation list by 3/08 (received infra logs).

I've added a short (2-line) recommended messaging for the board: a) we identified causes, b) remediation plans are in progress, c) expected net impact to ARR is minimal.

I'll push the slide draft to the Drive folder and ping Jordan once it's ready for final copy.

-Marissa
